name: 08 Trust center
nodes: What Relay can do for you
Set by your admins in policy v14. Written in plain language so you always know what happens in your name.
Relay drafts emails and Slack messages for you. It sends on its own only to 10 internal people or fewer;
anything bigger, or outside the company, waits for you.
Relay can read and create private drafts in Drive and Jira. It never shares a file outside Northwind.
Relay can open pull requests. It can’t merge, and it can’t touch protected branches.
Relay can prepare deal updates and invoices. A person always confirms them.
RELAY NEVER DOES THIS, FOR ANYONE
Ask your admin to change a rule
